body:
## Plot sizes and listed rates

The supplied Ring Road Block sheet lists five sizes: 5.56 Marla, 8 Marla, 10.89 Marla, 14.22 Marla and 1 Kanal. The discounted prices range from PKR 2,790,000 to PKR 8,120,000. A listed size is a price reference, not confirmation that a particular plot remains available.

## Full-payment availability

Our Ring Road Block offers follow the current full-payment policy. We are not offering 5 marla or 5.56 Marla installments. Possible K Block options for 10 marla and above are separate and require confirmation; they should not be assumed to apply to Ring Road Block.

## Development charges and location premiums

The sheet states that development charges are included in the cost of the plot. It separately lists a PKR 20,000 registration fee. Request an itemized final quotation so the registration treatment of the discounted price is clear.

The sheet also lists possible location premiums: 15% for main-road corner plots, 10% for main-road or proper-corner plots, and 5% for short-corner or certain other preferred locations. Confirm the applicable category and calculation for the exact plot before relying on a total.

## Location and layout checks

Ask for the exact plot number marked on the current block plan and a location pin. A dedicated Ring Road Block layout has not been supplied for this page, so the promotional launch artwork should not be used as a plot-location map.

The plots are undeveloped. Check road access, boundaries and the actual ground conditions through a site visit or a dated walkthrough. The supplied plot visual and launch artwork are not verified site photographs.

## Before making a payment

Confirm the plot number, seller, itemized total, payment instructions and receipt procedure directly before payment. The [master-plan buyer checklist](/articles/faisal-town-ii-master-plan/#before-making-any-payment) covers the shared verification steps.
